results.title: US Open wildcards announced: Venus Williams and Stephens lead WTA inclusions, Monfils back for one last hurrah as Wawrinka and Draper snubbed
results.description: The US Open wildcards have been announced with some notable inclusions. The tournament is set to take place from August 3 - September 13 with the Williams sisters the most talked about when it comes to the wildcards.

results.title: ESPN co-founder Bill Rasmussen dies at 93 from the effects of Parkinson’s disease
results.description: ESPN historian Mike Soltys said Rasmussen died at his Florida home from the effects of Parkinson’s disease. Rasmussen announced in 2019 that he had been diagnosed with the degenerative disease in 2014.

results.title: Why Game Studios Are Turning to External Development Partnerships
results.description: Juego Studios discusses the evolution of external development, full-cycle production, AI-assisted workflows, LiveOps, porting, and why studios increasingly view external teams as long-term strategic partners instead of traditional outsourcing vendors.

results.title: Historic horse-drawn vehicles hoisted into California museum for upcoming gallery
results.description: Twelve horse-drawn vehicles and one horseless carriage were lifted by crane into the San Mateo County History Museum's second floor on August 17. The Redwood City, California museum will open a new gallery on November 7, called the Taube Family Carriage House and Automobile Gallery. It is part of the museum's $25 million expansion.

results.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. lauds Buckeye-commit little brother's talent
results.description: Marvin Harrison Jr. had a lot to live up to growing up as the son of a Pro Football Hall of Famer, and his little brother Jett also has some big shoes to fill.
